title: Local resources
text: Some sites cannot run acute troponin, so the pathway cannot be applied as written.

title: Which PE score
text: Wells, revised Geneva and YEARS lead to the same next steps, but protocols differ.

title: US versus Europe on dissection
text: ESC 2024 sends ADD-RS 2 or more to CT regardless of D-dimer; AHA guidance lacks consensus on the ADD-RS cut-off and on D-dimer.

title: Parallel hypotheses
text: No source found on prioritizing ACS, PE and dissection work-ups run at the same time.

title: Grey zone
text: Between rule-out and rule-in natriuretic peptide thresholds, about half of older patients have heart failure; echo and judgment decide.

title: Unsourced gate
text: The stabilization gate and the COPD/asthma branch need sourcing.

title: Upper abdominal pain
text: Right upper quadrant and epigastric pain are not covered; ultrasound is the usual first test for right upper quadrant pain.

title: Operator dependence
text: Ultrasound performance depends on operator training.

title: Clinical scores
text: Scores such as Alvarado were not sourced in this pass.

title: Rule validation
text: Early reviews noted the Ottawa SAH rule had mainly Canadian validation; check local validity.

title: CT/LP versus CT/CTA
text: ACEP recommends shared decision making between the two second-line strategies.

title: Red-flag evidence
text: Most red flags lack prospective data on specificity.

title: 2021 leftovers
text: Lactate and procalcitonin steps still cite the 2021 edition and need checking against 2026.

title: Children
text: The 2026 pediatric Surviving Sepsis guideline is separate and not included.

title: Two guidelines
text: US (2017) and European (2018) guidelines overlap but differ in detail.

title: Intermediate risk
text: Patients with neither high- nor low-risk features have no single sourced pathway here.

title: Orthostatic thresholds
text: Exact blood pressure criteria were not extracted in this pass.

title: Lower GI bleeding
text: Lower GI bleeding has a separate ACG guideline, not included.

title: Score cut-offs
text: Exact Wells DVT cut-offs differ between versions; prevalence bands are used instead.

title: Distal DVT
text: The clinical relevance of calf-vein clots found on ultrasound is uncertain.

title: Training
text: HINTS accuracy depends on examiner training, which most emergency physicians lack.

title: Pediatric stroke
text: The 2026 guideline adds pediatric recommendations, not encoded here.

title: Other mimics
text: Mimics other than glucose disorders are not sourced.

title: Red-flag evidence
text: Many red flags lack empirical support; validated thresholds are missing.

title: Vascular causes
text: Aortic aneurysm as a flank pain mimic was not sourced.
